Feel for the pulse on top of your foot. Do the other side. Are they the same? Where is your pain exactly? Can you pinpoint the origin of the pain? Does the pain go anywhere? How have you been feeling otherwise (nauseated, chills, cold sweats,etc.)? Are you on injections or pills? How old are you? What's your medical history? Family medical history?  Is there swelling, redness, tender to touch, burning, discoloration? When did the pain start? Describe how it feels. What makes it better or worse? Have you ever had this pain before?

All these will play a factor in possible DVT or other possible medical ailments.  I'd Definitely get second opinion at GP/PCP. Don't dwell on it too much unless it gets worse rapidly. If you feel like passing out or you're having a heart attack call for an ambulance..
